description: This file 'Adc_Internal.h' contains internal declarations, typedefs, function prototypes, and include directives for the ADC module within the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform. It manages internal state, validation functions, group status, and notification controls for ADC groups.
external_methods: Std_ReturnType ValidateGroup(const Adc_ConfigType *ConfigPtr, Adc_GroupType group, Adc_APIServiceIDType api)

methods.name: ValidateInit
methods.description: Validates whether the ADC has been initialized before allowing certain operations.

methods.name: ValidateGroup
methods.description: Validates whether the specified group is valid for the current ADC configuration.

methods.name: Adc_InternalGetGroupStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific ADC group, considering the current state and configuration.

methods.name: Adc_EnableInternalGroupNotification
methods.description: Enables notifications for a specified ADC group.

methods.name: Adc_InternalDisableGroupNotification
methods.description: Disables notifications for a specified ADC group.

methods.name: Adc_CheckReadGroup
methods.description: Checks if reading data from a specific ADC group is valid and permissible.

methods.name: Adc_CheckStartGroupConversion
methods.description: Checks if starting the conversion for a specific group is valid.

methods.name: Adc_CheckStopGroupConversion
methods.description: Checks if stopping the conversion for a specific group is valid.

methods.name: Adc_CheckInit
methods.description: Checks if the ADC is properly initialized before performing operations.

methods.name: Adc_CheckDeInit
methods.description: Checks if de-initialization of ADC is valid, conditioned on compile-time configuration.

methods.name: Adc_CheckSetupResultBuffer
methods.description: Checks if setting up the result buffer for a group is valid.

methods.name: Adc_CheckGetStreamLastPointer
methods.description: Checks if retrieving the last stream pointer for a group is valid.
